name: Snowkissed Romance
source: Your story begins with the anticipation of a fun girl’s trip with your best friend. With college entrance exams on the horizon, a much needed get-a-way is in order. Heading off to your aunt’s ski resort in Niseko, Japan, “The Powder Lodge,” you prepare for a relaxing week ahead. However, not long after arriving, your older brother shows up with his crew to crash the trip! Unfortunately, there are no other rooms left in your aunt's lodge, so the six of you are stuck to make do with the 2-bed flat. What's more, his three friends he brought along aren't just anyone, they are your childhood friends who moved away! Stuck in close quarters, you rekindle the relationships you once had with Usui, Yoh, and Kichirou. Will you suddenly find yourself falling in love at this beautiful mountain lodge?
translation: 故事开始时，你正满心期待与挚友来一场欢乐的女生旅行。大学入学考试近在眼前，正需要一次出游好好放松。你们前往姨妈位于日本二世古的滑雪度假旅馆“粉雪山庄”，准备度过轻松的一周。然而，刚到没多久，哥哥就带着他的朋友们突然出现，打乱了这场旅行！偏偏姨妈的旅馆已经没有空房，六个人只好挤在一间只有两张床的公寓房里。更何况，他带来的三个朋友可不是陌生人，而是你早已搬走的青梅竹马！在这狭小的空间里，你与Usui、Yoh和Kichirou重拾旧日情谊。在这座美丽的山间旅馆，你会不会忽然坠入爱河？
